verdict.rationale: Martin's docs have a dedicated background-tasks section that runs on its own: scheduled daily or weekly briefings, proactive email drafting and sending, automatic email triage with follow-up actions, scheduled wake-up calls, and cc-to-schedule meeting booking. Custom shortcuts and timed reminders add further automation. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined custom triggers or schedules beyond the preset background tasks, in-depth docs on configuring and monitoring these automations, and independent hands-on corroboration that they run reliably.
